Two limits worth stating rather than glossing: (1) academic recognition inside the EHEA is not professional recognition for a regulated profession — that runs through Directive 2005/36/EC and a separate national procedure, and does not arise for an analytics degree anyway; (2) recognition abroad still goes through the receiving country's own procedure — the EHEA makes it routine, not automatic.

programme_name: Maestría Oficial en Data Science & Business Analytics
city: ONLINE — 'Online con clases en directo' (live online classes). IMMUNE's own seat is Paseo de la Castellana 89, 28046 Madrid. The AWARDING university's seat is Panama City, Panama (UMECIT).
autonomous_community: Comunidad de Madrid (IMMUNE's seat only — the degree is not a Spanish degree and is not registered in any Spanish autonomous community)
campus: No campus teaching for this programme — online with live classes; IMMUNE's Madrid campus at Paseo de la Castellana 89 hosts its other programmes
university_awarding: Universidad Metropolitana de Educación, Ciencia y Tecnología (UMECIT), PANAMA — a Panamanian private university. NOT a Spanish university. IMMUNE itself is a private technology school and is not a university.
official_status: TÍTULO PROPIO IN SPAIN — and this is the trap. The word 'Oficial' in the programme's own name means officially recognised IN PANAMA, COLOMBIA AND ECUADOR, not in Spain. Verbatim from the programme page: 'Título oficial en Panamá, Colombia y Ecuador por la Universidad Metropolitana de Educación, Ciencia y Tecnología (UMECIT)'. It is NOT a Spanish Máster Universitario, is NOT ANECA-verified and is NOT in RUCT.
ruct_code: NONE — not a Spanish official title; no RUCT code exists and none is claimed
meces_level: NOT APPLICABLE — outside MECES. MECES levels attach to Spanish official qualifications; a Panamanian maestría has no MECES level unless and until the holder obtains a Spanish 'equivalencia de nivel académico' or 'homologación' through the Ministerio de Universidades, which is a separate, applicant-initiated, fee-paying procedure with no guaranteed outcome and is neither included nor mentioned here.
eqf_level: NOT APPLICABLE — no EQF level; Panama is not in the EQF/EHEA
europe_recognition: NOT recognised across Europe as a degree. Panama is NOT a member of the European Higher Education Area (Bologna), so this qualification sits OUTSIDE the EHEA and OUTSIDE MECES, carries NO Diploma Supplement as of right (the Diploma Supplement is an EHEA instrument), and grants NO access to Spanish or other EHEA doctoral study without a prior, separately-applied-for recognition decision by the receiving country. Recognition anywhere in Europe is entirely at the discretion of the receiving institution or employer. The claim carried by the programme's own title — 'Oficial' — is legally true but is about PANAMA, COLOMBIA and ECUADOR, and the page says so in terms; read as a Spanish or European credential it is misleading, and it must not be relayed as such. Note also what the graduate actually receives from IMMUNE: the FAQ answers '¿Qué título o acreditación se entrega al terminar?' with 'recibirás un título emitido por IMMUNE Technology Institute en formato digital verificable mediante tecnología blockchain' — a blockchain-verified school certificate, which is not a degree in any jurisdiction.
phd_access: NO — not in Spain or the EHEA without a prior individual homologación/equivalencia decision
tuition_eu_eur: NOT FOUND — IMMUNE publishes no tuition figure for this programme anywhere on the programme page. The page offers only financing routes ('Pago al contado — consulta los descuentos disponibles', Sequra instalments, FUNDAE bonificada, becas 'en función del perfil de los alumnos'), i.e. price is disclosed only after an admissions conversation. Do not accept any aggregator figure for this programme.
tuition_non_eu_eur: NOT FOUND — no tuition figure published at all, therefore no EU/non-EU comparison can be made. Page silence is NOT FOUND, not 'no surcharge'.
tuition_year_of_rates: NOT FOUND for tuition. The non-academic fee schedule below states 'Precios válidos hasta diciembre 2026'.
fees_extra_eur: Published in IMMUNE's own fee schedule 'Tasas de servicios no académicos' (prices valid to December 2026). Reserva de plaza for 'Másters oficiales' EUR 300 (included in the matrícula). Then, under the heading 'PROGRAMAS OFICIALES — La Universidad Metropolitana de Educación, Ciencia y Tecnología (UMECIT), Panamá': expedición de título UMECIT EUR 200; derecho de grado (Maestría) EUR 250; apostilla EUR 150 'para estudiantes no panameños'; examen de 2ª lengua EUR 125; revisión gramatical del trabajo de grado EUR 1 per page. For this non-Panamanian candidate that is EUR 725 of graduation fees on top of tuition, before per-page proofreading. Further: certificado normal EUR 20 / urgente EUR 75, +EUR 20 if in a language other than Spanish; cambio de convocatoria EUR 75 first, EUR 150 second; and a late-thesis penalty of EUR 75 + 10% of the matrícula if the trabajo de grado is not delivered within four months.
modality: online with live classes ('Online con clases en directo')
language_of_instruction: Spanish — the programme page, curriculum, FAQs and all UMECIT regulations on it are in Spanish; UMECIT's admission rules require foreign documents to be apostilled and translated 'en idioma castellano'. No English-taught option is offered for this programme. Hard filter for a candidate at A0/A1 Spanish. (An English (UK) site toggle exists but is a site-wide UI language switch, not evidence of the teaching language.)
start_month: March — page banner: 'Convocatoria abierta para marzo, septiembre y octubre'. The programme header separately advertises 'Próxima convocatoria: Octubre 2026'. March is the Jan–Jun intake.
notes: THE DECISIVE FINDING, stated precisely: IMMUNE's 'Maestría Oficial' is officially PANAMANIAN, awarded by UMECIT, and is not a Spanish official master's. IMMUNE's own internal fee schedule confirms the architecture better than its marketing does: it splits its catalogue into 'PROGRAMAS PROPIOS' (IMMUNE's own certificates) and 'PROGRAMAS OFICIALES', and every institution listed under 'oficiales' is foreign — UMECIT (Panamá), Instituto de Posgrado en Inteligencia Artificial IPIA (México), Fundación Universitaria Los Libertadores (Colombia), Dublin Business School (Irlanda). No Spanish university appears anywhere in it. CREDITS: the page states '60 Créditos', NOT '60 ECTS'; these are UMECIT credits under a Panamanian plan and no ECTS equivalence is claimed or evidenced — do not record them as ECTS. GRADUATION CONDITIONS are UMECIT's own and are unusual for a Spanish reader: cumulative GPA not below 2.00 on a 3.00 scale; every subject passed at 81/100 minimum ('equivalente a una B'); a certified second language recognised by UNESCO (a paid EUR 125 exam — this candidate's Arabic/French/English profile satisfies the substance easily); financial clearance; and a trabajo de grado with a four-month delivery window backed by a penalty tariff. ENTRY: 'No son necesarios conocimientos previos'; admission is solicitud + entrevista personal + comisión académica + matrícula. The 300-ECTS engineering degree far exceeds the bar but there is no credit-recognition or advanced-standing scheme, and none could apply since the credit system is not ECTS. VISA WARNING for this non-EU candidate: the programme is delivered online by a non-university school under a Panamanian award — that is a weak basis for a Spanish student visa, which is granted for study at an authorised centre; verify with the consulate before treating this as a route to Spain. NOT FOUND: tuition (any figure), any Spanish accreditation, any RUCT or BOE reference, any ECTS statement.

institution_type: public university (Universitat de Barcelona) acting through its private-law continuing-education foundation, IL3. official_status: TÍTULO PROPIO — and not even a máster propio. The page's own wording, verbatim: 'Acreditación académica: Diploma de Experto en Inteligencia Artificial Aplicada a la Música por la Universitat de Barcelona. Curso propio diseñado según las directrices del Espacio Europeo de Educación Superior y equivalente a 15 créditos ECTS.' 'Tipología: Curso'. It is a 15-ECTS expert diploma, not a master's of any kind: not ANECA-verified, not in RUCT.
ruct_code: NONE — curso propio; no RUCT code exists and none is claimed
europe_recognition: NOT recognised across Europe as a qualification. This is a UB curso propio: it sits OUTSIDE MECES and OUTSIDE the European Higher Education Area (Bologna) framework, carries NO Diploma Supplement as of right, and grants NO doctoral access. Recognition in another European country is entirely at the discretion of the receiving institution or employer. NAMING THE LEGAL BASIS of the school's own claim, as required: the page says the course is 'diseñado según las directrices del Espacio Europeo de Educación Superior y equivalente a 15 créditos ECTS'. That is a statement about DESIGN and workload convention — the syllabus was built to EHEA credit conventions and UB rates it at 15 ECTS of student workload. It is NOT a statement that the qualification is placed in the EHEA qualifications framework, and it confers no automatic recognition anywhere. The ECTS figure is UB's own workload rating attached to a non-official certificate; it may well be accepted for credit transfer by a receiving university, but that is a discretionary decision, not an entitlement. The reputational weight here is real and worth stating separately from the legal weight: the awarding institution is a genuine public university (UB), which is a materially different situation from a private academy's self-issued certificate — but it does not change the legal category.
tuition_eu_eur: EUR 2,200 for the full course. Verbatim: 'Precio 2.200 € (El precio incluye tasas administrativas de la Universidad de Barcelona)'. 15 ECTS, so EUR 146.67 per ECTS (2,200 ÷ 15).
tuition_non_eu_eur: EUR 2,200 — SAME as EU. Flat single rate: the page publishes one price and no nationality-, residency- or EU/non-EU-based tier of any kind. This matters and is a genuine finding: UB's confirmed non-EU surcharge applies to its OFFICIAL titles under the Catalan decret de preus públics, and a curso propio is priced commercially and outside that decree, so the surcharge does not reach this course. Note for completeness: Catalonia's Decret 96/2026 art. 1.5 confirms a long-stay study authorisation does not confer resident status, so this candidate would be non-resident for fee purposes on any OFFICIAL Catalan programme — but that is irrelevant to this particular price.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2027 cohort (course dates 13/04/2027 – 16/11/2027), price as published and accessed 2026-08-29
fees_extra_eur: NONE PUBLISHED beyond the price — UB administrative fees are stated to be included ('El precio incluye tasas administrativas de la Universidad de Barcelona'). Discounts of 10% are offered to members/employees of APECAT (Asociación de Productores y Editores Fonográficos y Videográficos Catalanes), the Barcelona Music Tech Hub and the Acadèmia Catalana de la Música; discounts are not cumulative, are not retroactive, and must be accredited before the course starts.
modality: presencial (Barcelona), 31 weeks, Tuesdays 18:00–21:00 plus one Friday a month in the same slot; remote attendance possible for some students. 90 'horas bonificadas' for the Spanish FUNDAE employer-subsidy calculation.
language_of_instruction: Spanish — 'Idioma: Castellano', stated in the programme's own Datos básicos block. Hard filter for a candidate at A0/A1 Spanish.
start_month: April 2027 — 'Fechas 13/4/2027 - 16/11/2027'. Note this is a spring START but it runs to mid-November, so it overlaps a September 2027 master's start.
notes: SIZE AND CATEGORY ARE THE POINT: 15 ECTS, 'Tipología: Curso', part-time evening delivery over 31 weeks. This is a specialist top-up, not a degree, and it is a quarter the size of a 60-ECTS master. For a non-EU applicant it is very unlikely to support a Spanish student visa on its own — long-stay study authorisations require full-time study, and a Tuesday-evening course is not that; treat it strictly as a complement to something else, and verify with the consulate before relying on it. ENTRY REQUIREMENT, verbatim: 'Se requiere disponer de una titulación relacionada con el ámbito musical (ciclo formativo de grado superior, grado, posgrado o máster), o bien tener experiencia profesional o en prácticas de al menos un año.' The candidate's 300-ECTS Software Engineering degree does NOT satisfy the first limb (it is not a music-related qualification), but the alternative limb is satisfiable: as a working music producer/DJ he can evidence at least one year of professional experience in the field. The 300 ECTS earn nothing here — there is no credit-recognition or advanced-standing scheme for a curso propio. CONTENT is a genuine B/AI-for-music fit (AI ethics and law in music, royalties traceability and infringement detection, digital distribution and AI marketing, audience segmentation and recommendation), taught by a Barcelona industry faculty. Note IL3 also runs a 60-ECTS 'Máster en Industria Musical' and a 30-ECTS 'Formación de Postgrado en Gestión de la Industria Musical', both presencial and both listed as related programmes — also títulos propios, and not enriched here. DOMAIN NOTE for future agents: il3.ub.edu is listed as blocked in the shared brief, but it returned HTTP 200 and a full 211 KB body to curl with a COMPLETE browser header set (Sec-Ch-Ua-* and Sec-Fetch-* included). It is reachable; the block entry should be corrected. NOT FOUND: nothing material — price, dates, credits, language, modality, venue and entry rules are all stated on the page.
